response.justification: Szabo presents an interesting profile with current staff-level role at re:cinq working on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks, directly aligned with the role's agentic workflow focus. However, the resume lacks explicit evidence of core required competencies: vector database implementation, RAG architecture design, data pipeline construction, and LLM optimization techniques. His deep software engineering background and customer-facing leadership provide a solid foundation, but the gap in demonstrated GenAI system design expertise creates significant uncertainty that would require in-depth technical discussion to resolve.
strengths: Currently working on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks at re:cinq, directly aligned with the role's focus on agentic workflows and production AI systems
Strong TypeScript and full-stack engineering expertise with multiple staff-level positions demonstrating technical leadership and team mentoring capabilities
Proven cloud infrastructure and DevOps knowledge (AWS CDK, Docker, Kubernetes) combined with software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, microservices)
concerns: No demonstrated experience with vector databases, RAG architectures, or retrieval systems—explicitly listed as required qualifications
Resume lacks evidence of building data pipelines for AI/ML systems or optimizing LLM performance metrics, both required competencies
No Python experience mentioned despite being a primary required language; recent pivot to AI domain (April 2025) raises questions about depth of GenAI system design expertise

key_factors.factor: Missing core GenAI tech stack (vector DBs, RAG, LLM metrics)
Current AI-agent infrastructure and MCP framework role
Strong software engineering foundation and staff-level leadership
